newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - No abortion deal on Telstra - Fischer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - No abortion deal on Telstra - Fischer.

text.p: Australian acting prime minister Tim Fischer said on Tuesday the government would not abolish Medicare coverage for abortions in return for a key Independent senator's vote for the Telstra privatisation.

"Tim Fischer had also said that there was no deal in relation to that but that he would call upon Michael Wooldridge as the minister for health to say that again, and Michael did," a Liberal-National coalition spokesman said, reporting from a private joint-party meeting.

Fischer said on Sunday that Independent senator Brian Harradine had corresponded with the government on the question of abolishing abortion coverage under Medicare, the national health insurance scheme.
The government needs the vote of Harradine and another Independent to get legislation authorising a one-third sale of Telstra through the Senate.
